failure_modes: Fit that captures a correlation and not a mechanism
gloss: Compress a complex phenomenon into a short interpretable equation
invariants: Every parameter in the result has a stated meaning
The equation fits data across instances, not one case
mechanism: Collect data across many instances, search by analysis for an invariant relation, and express it as a compact equation in which each parameter and interaction has a known meaning. The classic example relates heartbeat rate, body size, and lifespan, yielding a near-constant number of heartbeats per life across species.
